_comment: Per-app endpoint ACCOUNTABILITY (not isolation). Apps are same-origin iframes, so any app can mint any app's token via POST /api/app/token; enforced=true gives least-privilege-by-convention and logging, NOT a security boundary against a malicious app. Real safety for dangerous endpoints comes from the account PASSWORD at the route itself (remote/exec, recovery/debug, factory-reset, restore, clear-password), never from this file. Paths not listed here stay open to every app.
